game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage, a half-collapsed passage: the lantern keeper must handle glow-eyed lurkers while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Nested While Dungeon: Run an inner loop for each room inside an outer loop for each floor.
theme: Shadow Cave – Collapsed Passage: a half-collapsed passage
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Archive variation 5: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Compilation.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: The rival reaches the lantern post first, or lives reach 0.
